title: Geometric properties of slowly rotating black holes embedded in matter environments
summary: Extreme mass-ratio inspirals (EMRIs) provide a precise probe of strong-field gravity, where small deviations from vacuum Kerr geometry can accumulate over many orbital cycles. In realistic astrophysical settings, black holes are embedded in surrounding dark and baryonic matter whose presence and motion can perturb the spacetime.
